categories.name: Black Plastic Containers
categories.description: Plastic containers, whether numbered or unnumbered, that are colored black. Excludes single-use utensils and non-container plastics.

categories.name: Containers #1/Clamshells
categories.description: Plastic containers or lids that are labelled as PETE, PET, or #1 (polyethylene terephthalate) without a screw-off lid.

categories.name: Containers #2 Colored
categories.description: Plastic containers that are labelled as HDPE, PEHD, or #2 that are pigmented (excluding black).

categories.name: Containers #2 Natural
categories.description: Plastic containers that are labelled as HDPE, PEHD, or #2 that are opaque.

categories.name: Containers #3-7 (Not #5)
categories.description: Plastic containers that are labeled #3 PVC, #4 LDPE, #6 PS, #7 PLA (excluding #5). Does not include EPS, even if labelled #6.

categories.name: Containers #5/PP
categories.description: Plastic containers that are labeled PP (polypropylene) or #5.

categories.name: Deposit #1 Bottles
categories.description: Plastic containers that are labelled as PETE, PET, or #1 (polyethylene terephthalate) with NY Deposit listed. Must have a screw-off lid.

categories.name: Garbage Bags
categories.description: Disposable bag used line trash cans to hold solid waste. Includes bathroom trash bags and contractor bags.

categories.name: Other #1 Bottles
categories.description: Plastic containers that are labelled as PETE, PET, or #1 (polyethylene terephthalate) without NY Deposit listed. Must have a screw-off lid.

categories.name: Other Plastic Film
categories.description: A thin, continuous form of plastic material often used to create bags or packaging.

categories.name: Other Plastics
categories.description: All remaining plastics not listed above.

categories.name: Other Rigid/Bulky Plastics
categories.description: Plastics that are the size of a 5-gallon bucket or larger.

categories.name: Other Unnumbered Containers & Fragments
categories.description: Any loose / unnumbered plastic lids, tops, caps, containers, or container fragments.
